ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarti Drugs Limited has filed its quarterly compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5), confirming its Registrar and Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India Private Limited, properly processed all dematerialization requests for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This confirms that securities received were duly accepted/rejected, listed, physical certificates mutilated/cancelled, and the register of members updated within prescribed timelines. The document indicates strong regulatory compliance and sound corporate governance practices regarding shareholder record management, with no red flags or material negative impacts identified.
